The merge takes the second task vector against the already-modified tensor instead of the unmodified base: it computes `tmp = b + λ(f1 - b)` and then `tmp + λ(f2 - tmp)`, whereas step 2 of "Required result" requires `base + λ(ft1 - base) + λ(ft2 - base)`. Expanding the artifact's expression gives `(1-λ)·base + λ(1-λ)(ft1 - base) + λ·ft2`, which is not equal to the specified formula and is exactly the ordering hazard the specification warns about, so the 64 merged tensors will exceed the 1e-3 relative Frobenius tolerance. The shared-tensor verification, merge count, output count, dtype handling and unchanged-tensor passthrough are otherwise correct.
